newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean firms pass on 25,500T rapemeal tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean firms pass on 25,500T rapemeal tenders.

text.p: A South Korean buyer group, known as "Big Feed Mills", passed on tenders to buy 25,500 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal due to high offer prices, officials of the buyer group said on Wednesday.

The officials said arrival for the first 8,000 tonnes was originally set by July 10, the second 9,000 tonnes by August 10 and the rest by September 10. Arrival ports were set to South Korean port cities of Kunsan and Ulsan.
The lowest bids were made by Nidera at $144.98 a tonne C&F for 13,000 tonnes for arrival by July 10 and at $145,98 a tonne C&F for another 12,000 tonnes for arrival by August 10, they added.
